rules: Project-level shared ceiling is not a per-thread allowance. All participating workers, retries and review calls must share the meter.
Each model route also obeys its own deployment and response-header limits and RPM/short-window restrictions; a higher project ceiling does not raise a lower model limit.
Use min(user ceiling, configured route allocation, currently observed provider limit), with shared headroom and backoff. No quota-bypass or automatic model substitution.
Never combine Luna prices with Astra capacity in an attainable-runtime quote. 1M Luna scenarios are conditional until that deployment actually permits it.
Admission accounting must use the provider estimated-token policy and requested maximum output, not only final billed tokens. Add per-stage timing before a later throughput test.
No new inference is admitted on the assumption that missing local status means unprocessed. Reconcile existing metadata and exact compatible input/field provenance first.
Reuse the completed narrow base, old field-reuse map and keyed additive overlays; do not invent a replacement cleaning framework.

Accepted fields are frozen. Saved_unverified is audited rather than blindly rerun. Reviewed_unknown is preserved, not a negative or automatically queued work. Protected tasks remain deny-only and never rerouted.
Unknown whole-delivery denominator and global accepted-key union remain unresolved; do not subtract mismatched source rows, contexts, candidates or overlapping samples.
next_required_step: Finish record/field-level union using migrated manifests and accepted ledgers, consume existing exact-context references; only verified missing eligible semantic fields may enter a later bounded production decision.
